name: agent_auth
docs: Interface of the AgentAuth core program AFTER hardening. LOCKED: the 2136-byte layout and every existing offset, the verify ABI (tag 3, 49 bytes) and error codes 1..18. APPENDED: instructions 5..6 and error codes 19..22, and two header bytes taken from the reserved area (version @79, bump @80). Where this file says "target", the implementation must match it; any deviation must be reported and this file updated.
generatedBy: baseline interface read from commit 7677fef (design/tools/gen_artifacts.py) + hardening decisions of 2026-10-10; the core-fix work package owns this file and must keep it equal to the implementation

instructions.name: create_mandate
instructions.dataLengthNote: exactly 9 bytes: tag + i64 expiry (anything else => 15)

args.name: expiry
args.desc: unix timestamp; the FIRST second at which the mandate is invalid (expired iff now >= expiry); must be > now at creation (else 20)

accounts.name: agent
accounts.desc: agent pubkey (any key; not required to sign)

instructions.checks: accounts>=3 else 15; owner signer else 18; owner != agent else 19; PDA match else 16; data==9 else 15; expiry>now else 20; discriminator==1 (already initialised) else 3; pre-funded or system-owned PDA => Transfer(top-up to rent)+Allocate(2136)+Assign(AgentAuth) signed by PDA seeds; program-owned zero husk => initialise in place; otherwise CreateAccount
instructions.writes: disc=1, version=1, bump, owner, agent, expiry, active=1, permissions_len=0

instructions.name: add_permission
instructions.checks: accounts>=2 else 15; owner signer else 18; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; len 2136 else 15; disc==1 else 16; active else 4; owner match else 2; data>=50 else 15; disc_len==0 else 22; disc_len<=8 else 11; data==50+8n else 15; len<16 else 10; duplicate program id else 21

instructions.name: remove_permission

args.name: target_program
args.desc: removes the WHOLE permission slot of that program (all its discriminators)

instructions.checks: as add_permission up to the owner check; data==33 else 15; program not found else 12; swap-remove (last slot moves into the hole, tail zeroed)

instructions.name: verify

accounts.name: owner
accounts.desc: must equal mandate.owner (not required to sign)

instructions.checks: data (after tag) == 48 else 15; accounts>=3 else NotEnoughAccountKeys; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; len 2136 else 15; disc==1 else 16; active else 4; now<expiry else 5 (expired iff now >= expiry); owner key else 2; agent key else 17; agent signer else 18; program slot else 6; discriminator else 7; per_tx else 8; lifetime else 9 (a limited permission whose spend_total+amount overflows u64 => 9)
instructions.writes: slot.spend_total += amount; slot.call_count += 1 (saturating for an unlimited permission: verify never reverts because of counter overflow)
instructions.advisory: verify trusts caller-reported program/discriminator/amount and any program can call it: it is advisory unless the integrator makes it a precondition of an action it controls.

instructions.name: revoke_mandate

accounts.name: system_program
accounts.desc: optional: ignored by the current source; the repo test helper passes it

instructions.checks: accounts>=2 else 15; owner signer else 18; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; len 2136 else 15; disc==1 else 16; owner match else 2; PDA verified with the stored bump else 16; data==1 else 15
instructions.writes: REAL close: all lamports to owner, data zeroed and shrunk to 0 bytes, account assigned to the System Program (no program-owned husk can remain; the address can be re-funded and re-used)

instructions.name: set_active
instructions.checks: accounts>=2 else 15; owner signer else 18; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; len 2136 else 15; disc==1 else 16; owner match else 2; data==2 else 15; value in {0,1} else 15
instructions.writes: header.active = value. Works on paused mandates. While paused, verify => 4 NotActive and add/remove/update => 4. Counters and permissions are preserved. revoke_mandate stays the destructive kill switch.

instructions.name: update_permission

args.name: per_tx_limit
args.desc: new per verify call cap, 0 = unlimited

instructions.checks: as add_permission up to the owner check (including active else 4); data==49 else 15; program not found else 12
instructions.writes: slot.spend_limit and slot.per_tx_limit replaced; spend_total, call_count and the discriminator list are PRESERVED (changing a limit does not grant a fresh budget)

fields.name: active
fields.desc: 1 active, 0 paused (set_active). revoke_mandate closes the account instead

fields.name: version
fields.desc: layout/semantics version, 1 for this release (written by create_mandate)

fields.name: bump
fields.desc: PDA bump, stored so handlers never search for it (written by create_mandate)

errors.name: InvalidDiscriminator
errors.msg: Unknown instruction tag

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: Signer / owner key is not the mandate owner

errors.name: AlreadyInitialized
errors.msg: Mandate already initialised

errors.name: NotActive
errors.msg: Mandate is paused (set_active 0); resume it or create a new one

errors.name: Expired
errors.msg: now > mandate.expiry

errors.name: ProgramNotAllowed
errors.msg: No permission slot for the reported target program id

errors.name: DiscriminatorNotAllowed
errors.msg: Reported discriminator not in the slot's allow-list (an empty list allows nothing)

errors.name: PerTxExceeded
errors.msg: amount > per_tx_limit (0 = unlimited)

errors.name: SpendLimitExceeded
errors.msg: spend_total + amount > spend_limit (0 = unlimited)

errors.name: PermissionsFull
errors.msg: 16 permission slots already used

errors.name: TooManyDiscriminators
errors.msg: More than 8 discriminators in one permission

errors.name: PermissionNotFound
errors.msg: No slot for that program id; ALSO (quirk) returned when the owner did not sign create/add/remove

errors.name: ArithmeticOverflow
errors.msg: Checked add overflowed

errors.name: AccountOwnerMismatch
errors.msg: revoke_mandate: mandate account not owned by AgentAuth

errors.name: InvalidInstructionData
errors.msg: Wrong data length / too few accounts / wrong account length / duplicate permission program

errors.name: InvalidAccountType
errors.msg: Mandate discriminator byte != 1, or account not owned by AgentAuth

errors.name: UnknownAgent
errors.msg: verify: agent account key != mandate.agent

errors.name: InvalidSigner
errors.msg: A required signature is missing: owner (create/add/remove/update/set_active/revoke) or agent (verify)

errors.name: InvalidAgent
errors.msg: create_mandate: owner and agent must be different keys

errors.name: InvalidExpiry
errors.msg: create_mandate: expiry must be in the future

errors.name: DuplicatePermission
errors.msg: add_permission: a permission for this program already exists (use update_permission)

errors.name: EmptyDiscriminators
errors.msg: add_permission: at least one discriminator is required

quirks: One permission slot per program id (duplicate add => 21). remove_permission removes the whole slot (all its discriminators); use update_permission to change limits without resetting spend_total/call_count.
spend_limit == 0 and per_tx_limit == 0 mean UNLIMITED (fail-open sentinel kept for layout compatibility). SDK/CLI/dashboard must require an explicit "unlimited" opt-in.

Spend counters are keyed by TARGET PROGRAM and unit-less: every mint/decimal of the SPL Token program shares one raw-unit counter. Hard per-asset budgets need the relay (it pins the mint) or one mandate per asset.

verify trusts the caller-reported program id / discriminator / amount. It is advisory unless the integrator derives those values itself from the action it is about to perform (as the relay does) and gates the action on the result.

Anyone can create a mandate that names any agent with themselves as owner. Integrators MUST bind mandate.owner to the owner of the assets/authority they protect, and MUST hard-code the AgentAuth program id (see crates/agent-auth-cpi).
The mandate has no nonce/created_at: a re-created mandate for the same (owner, agent) has the same address. Consumers (the relay) bind to the stored expiry/bump generation.
Expiry is the first second at which the mandate is invalid (expired iff now >= expiry).
